question: Does current main already supersede `47142c9`, or should Crabpot intentionally adopt this QQBot revision after resolving the isolated fixture failure?
rationale: The correct outcome depends on the intended fixture pin and interpretation of a compatibility-lane failure across a substantial upstream refactor; that repository ownership choice cannot be resolved safely from the one-line gitlink diff alone.

options.title: Verify and close as obsolete
options.body: Confirm that current main pins `47142c9` or a descendant with equivalent coverage, then close this dependency branch without merging it.

options.title: Rebase and validate the pin
options.body: Rebase onto current main and rerun isolated source-mode and package-mode QQBot checks, updating generated expectations only when inspector behavior legitimately changed.

options.title: Retain the current fixture revision
options.body: Close the bump without adoption if the upstream architecture or installer changes no longer represent the seam Crabpot intends to exercise.

recommendation.title: Verify and close as obsolete
recommendation.body: Confirm that current main pins `47142c9` or a descendant with equivalent coverage, then close this dependency branch without merging it.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc is the strongest available routing candidate for Crabpot fixture and plugin-inspector compatibility decisions.
